The Independent Development Trust, the suicide and fake news -

By: Marion Edmunds | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Journalist Pieter-Louis Myburgh explains how he was framed by politicians and colleagues in a bizarre bid to diver attention away from corruption allegations at the IDT

Unique Selling Point:
We have background information provided by a whistleblower as well as access to the journalist who can explain to us how he attempted to investigate corruption in a series of stories which appear to have triggered a push-back in the form of fake news, publicised by politicians and fellow journalists.

Summary:
Last year, news broke of a corrupt tender handled by the Independent Development Trust on behalf of the Department of Health to supply medical oxygen facilities to 55 hospitals across the country. The journalist in question wrote an article about it and attempted to meet the director of the so-called ghost company which had got the tender. They met - but three days later he was dead, and the cause of death was suicide. It was clear to Pieter-Louis that there was more to this story, and possibly a bigger tale of corruption at the IDT. As a result of digging, he found himself hot on the tail of other tenders. But suddenly in early January, he also found himself flagged as a corrupt player in allegations aired in the media by fellow media practitioners and politicians, who accused him of receiving cash to plant bad stories on behalf of the Minister of Public Works. The stories were eventually retracted but the battle lines have been drawn.

FINAL SCRIPT - IDT_FAKE NEWS #6661

(VO1) JOURNALIST PIETER-LOUIS MYBURGH HAS MADE MANY ENEMIES THROUGH HIS CAREER.

(VO2) HE’S REPORTED IN DEPTH ON CORRUPTION SAGAS, OUTING POWERFULLY CONNECTED POLITICIANS AND THEIR HENCHMEN.

Sound-up: It all just goes to show that when we put together these investigative reports…

LAST WEEK WHILE ON THE TRAIL OF DODGY TENDERS - HE HIMSELF WAS ACCUSED OF BEING CORRUPT - AND DRAGGED INTO THE STORY.

(VO3) A NEWSPAPER PUBLISHED AN ARTICLE ALLEGING THAT A JOURNALIST HAD BEEN BRIBED TO WRITE A STORY ABOUT A STATE-OWNED ENTERPRISE CALLED THE INDEPENDENT DEVELOPMENT TRUST OR IDT. MYBURGH BELIEVES THAT THE JOURNALIST REFERENCED IN THIS ALLEGATION WAS MEANT TO BE HIM.

Pieter Louis Myburgh: There is this ongoing effort, really to cast doubt over investigative journalist who bring public, important public interests issues to the fore.

(VO4) THE CONTENTIOUS ARTICLE CLAIMED THAT PUBLIC WORKS MINISTER DEAN MACPHERSON OFFERED THE BRIBE BECAUSE HE WANTED TO DISCREDIT THE LEADERSHIP OF THE IDT IN ORDER TO SWAP IN DA POLITICAL APPOINTEES.

(VO5) IN AN UNCANNY COINCIDENCE, ON THE SAME DAY THAT THE ARTICLE WAS PUBLISHED, A SET OF STARTLING WHATSAPP MESSAGES AND A LOG OF TELEPHONE CALLS WERE SENT TO THE MINISTER FOR COMMENT.

THESE ANONYMOUSLY-SOURCED SCREENGRABS WERE SAID TO BE CIRCULATING ONLINE.

MYBURGH’s TELEPHONE NUMBER WAS IN THEM, WITH TEXTS EXPLICITLY DISCUSSING PAYMENT FOR PLANTING A STORY ABOUT THE IDT.

Pieter-Louis Myburgh: I can only wonder if you know, I've hit a nerve somewhere where I've started reporting on a entity, the IDT, that hasn't, hasn't really in the past, gotten that much scrutiny

Erin Bates: Is there any fragment of truth to the allegation?

Pieter-Louis Myburgh: There's not a hint of truth.


(VO6) FALLING UNDER THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS, THE IDT’S JOB IS TO MANAGE THE BIDDING PROCESS FOR INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS LIKE SCHOOLS AND HOSPITALS.

PIECE TO CAMERA ERIN BATES: OUTSIDE THE WORLD OF CONSTRUCTION AND PROCUREMENT, FEW PEOPLE EVEN KNOW THE IDT EXISTS.
BUT IT HANDLES BILLIONS OF RANDS OF TENDERS ANNUALLY.

(VO7) A TENDER TO SUPPLY OXYGEN TO PATIENTS IN HOSPITALS WAS THRUST INTO THE SPOTLIGHT IN A EXPOSE WRITTEN BY MYBURGH.

Pieter-Louis Myburgh: I spoke to a individual who was familiar with the the workings of the IDT, and he alerted me to the fact that there was a large contract awarded for these very important machines to be installed at government hospitals across the country, and I started looking at the contract, especially if there's hundreds of millions of rands involved. In this case, more than 800 million Rands.

(VO8) THE TENDER DOCUMENTS SHOWED THAT THE LARGEST SLICE OF THE CONTRACT WAS AWARDED TO A LITTLE KNOWN COMPANY CALLED BULKENG PTY LIMITED, WHICH WAS NOT CERTIFIED TO PROVIDE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT
MYBURGH TRACKED DOWN THE SOLE DIRECTOR, NKOSINATHI NDLOVU, AND MET WITH HIM AT A LAWYER’S OFFICE. MYBURGH SAYS THE BUSINESSMAN WAS AGITATED.

Pieter-Louis Myburgh: We met Mr. Ndlovu at his office on a Friday, and then on the Sunday, I received information that he had supposedly passed away. We did manage to establish that he had supposedly committed suicide.

(VO9) BY NOW, THE MINISTER OF PUBLIC WORKS WAS ASKING THE IDT FOR INFORMATION ABOUT THE OXYGEN TENDER.

Minister of Public Works, Dean MacPherson:
The IDT themselves issued a statement to say that indeed the oxygen tender should probably be investigated. I said that they cannot investigate themselves, and I would launch a forensic investigation, that is now underway

(VO10) BUT MACPHERSON HAS BEEN CHALLENGED.
POLITICIANS HAVE JUMPED ON BOTH THE UNSUBSTANTIATED ALLEGATIONS OF BRIBERY AND AN UNRELATED EMAIL WHICH THEY CLAIM MAY EXPOSE THE MINISTER AS CORRUPT.

Minister of Public Works, Dean MacPherson: Let's be honest, since I've come into office, the resistance by criminal networks that exist within this department, syndicates and in other entities, is huge. They do not want anything to be cleaned up, and they want the status quo to remain. I'm not prepared to do that.

(VO11) THE EFF HAS GONE SO FAR AS TO LAY A CORRUPTION CHARGE AGAINST MACPHERSON WITH THE POLICE, AS WELL AS A COMPLAINT WITH THE PUBLIC PROTECTOR. THE MINISTER HAS DENIED ALL THE ALLEGATIONS.
PIECE TO CAMERA ERIN BATES: IRONICALLY THE PUSH-BACK AGAINST ANY INVESTIGATION EITHER BY THE MEDIA OR THE MINISTER HIGHLIGHTS THE TROUBLES WITHIN THE IDT.

(VO12) IN 2023, WHISTLEBLOWERS WITHIN THE IDT RAISED ALLEGATIONS ABOUT A DUBIOUS LEASE AGREEMENT, INFIGHTING AND GENERAL CORRUPTION, TRIGGERING FORENSIC INVESTIGATIONS.
CARTE BLANCHE HAS SPOKEN TO INDIVIDUALS WHO SAY THEY FEARED FOR THEIR LIVES.
THE CEO, TEBOGO MALAKA, EMPLOYED A PERMANENT SECURITY DETAIL.

CARTE BLANCHE HAS ASKED THE IDT FOR COMMENT BUT IT HAS NOT YET RESPONDED.

Pieter-Louis Myburgh: There are troublesome allegations of nepotism, allegedly corrupt contracts, mismanagement, etc. And I really think based on that, based on the oxygen plants contract and other issues that have been aired of late, it really seems that the IDT is an entity that should be looked at closely, and the public should be made aware of what's, what's really going on there.

(VO13) EARLIER THIS WEEK, TIMESLIVE WITHDREW THE CONTROVERSIAL ARTICLE, WITH AN APOLOGY, CITING A LACK OF EVIDENCE.

(VO14) BUT IN THIS BIZARRE STORY OF AN IRREGULAR CONTRACT, AN ALLEGED SUICIDE AND FAKE NEWS, LIE THE SEEDS OF AN EVEN GREATER SET OF REVELATIONS.

Minister of Public Works, Dean MacPherson: So, I've seen this movie before. I'm resolute. I will not be bullied, I will not be pressurized to back down, and I will expose the truth at all costs.




PROMO 1
Pieter-Louis Myburgh:
I can only wonder if you know, I've hit a nerve somewhere where I've started reporting on a entity, the IDT, that hasn't, hasn't really, in the past, gotten that much scrutiny
(VO) A DODGY CONTRACT, AN UNEXPECTED DEATH AND THE INDEPENDENT DEVELOPMENT TRUST.
Minister of Public Works: I will not be bullied, I will not be pressurized to back down, and I will expose the truth at all costs.



PROMO 2
Pieter-Louis Myburgh:I started looking at the the contract, especially if there's hundreds of millions of rands involved. In this case, more than 800 million Rands.

(VO) HIGH VALUE TENDERS, A STATE-OWNED ENTERPRISE, AND THE SAME OLD CORRUPTION STORY.

Pieter-Louis Myburgh:There are troublesome allegations of nepotism, allegedly corrupt contracts, It really seems like the IDT is an entity that should be looked at.



PROMO 3
Minister of Public Works: They do not want anything to be cleaned up, and they want the status quo to remain. I'm not prepared to do that.
(VO) SHADOWY SOURCES CREATE A FALSE NARRATIVE IN A CAMPAIGN TO DEFEND PROCUREMENT CHIEFS.
ERIN: Is there any fragment of truth to the allegation?

Pieter-Louis Myburgh: There's not a hint of truth.
